title: Rabbi Yehudah HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Mishnah Eduyot 8:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Eduyot.8.2), testifying with Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava concerning a minor Israelite girl, etc. Hyman suggests that possibly he is the son of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai mentioned in [Niddah 15a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.15a.4), where he disagrees with Rabbi Akiva.

notes.text: Eduyot calls the witness Rabbi Yehudah the Priest. Niddah calls Rabbi Akiva’s interlocutor Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai. Hyman suggests that they may be the same person. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1621&lang=en) discusses the same proposal and expresses doubt.
